name: coupon-hive
description: Interview shoppers, research current deals and genuine freebies, and prepare low-noise recurring watches.

interface.shortDescription: Find verified deals and build low-noise watches
interface.longDescription: Coupon Hive interviews you about what counts as a useful deal, searches broadly, verifies important terms at first-party sources, and prepares recurring watches that alert only when something materially changes.
defaultPrompt: Interview me and find the best currently verifiable deal for something I want.
Help me define what free means, then find genuine freebies near me or online.
Turn my shopping request into a quiet recurring watch that only reports meaningful changes.
